body:
## Context

Release-audit BLOCKER (undeclared breaking change; release-blockers.md, pkg:rails-guard). PR #507 added `package.json` and `.npmrc` to `DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE_TRUST_ROOTS` (packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/trust-roots.mjs:48-52). The list is not opt-in and not configurable: `resolveImmutableTrustRoots({ additional })` only concatenates (trust-roots.mjs:87-93; sole subtraction is the verifiedMigration carve-out). The only exemption, `isVersionOnlyChange`, covers version fields + `@adlc/*` dep ranges for manifest basenames only — `.npmrc` gets no exemption at all (packages/rails-guard/lib/version-only.mjs:46,168-191). Audit reproduction: consumer-shaped fixture, root package.json third-party devDependency bump — HEAD's runRailFreezeGate throws GateDeny exit 2; v1.10.0 exits 0. Same input, opposite verdict, minor bump, no CHANGELOG note, no README mention.

Decision (Chris, 2026-08-22 interrogation): audit option (a) — move the two paths out of the frozen defaults; the ADLC repo keeps its own protection through the existing `--trust-root` extras mechanism (scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs:79 already flat-maps REPO_TRUST_ROOTS into `--trust-root` flags). The in-file rationale for keeping GATE SOURCES in the defaults (trust-roots.mjs:16-35) is sound and stays; it does not extend to package.json/.npmrc, which exist in essentially every Node repo and are edited constantly.

## What to change

1. `packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/trust-roots.mjs` — remove `'package.json'` and `'.npmrc'` (and their npm-script/exec-flag rationale comment) from DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE_TRUST_ROOTS. Keep the gate-source rationale header intact.
2. `scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs` — add `'package.json'` and `'.npmrc'` to REPO_TRUST_ROOTS so THIS repo's posture is unchanged.
3. `packages/rails-guard/README.md` — new "Immutable trust roots" section: the frozen default set, the `--trust-root` extension flag, the #141 ceremony escape, the version-only exemption. (Today the README has zero mentions of "trust".)
4. `packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/args.mjs` USAGE — name where the default set lives and that `--trust-root` extends it.
5. `CHANGELOG.md` — add an `## [Unreleased]` entry declaring the in-window regression and its reversal (consumers keep 1.10.0 behavior; ADLC repo re-freezes via CI flags).
6. Tests (`packages/rails-guard/test/ci-trust-roots.test.mjs`) — update the deep-equal pin of the default set (:103); ADD a consumer-shaped regression test (fixture repo, root package.json third-party devDep bump, gate does NOT throw); keep ceremony coverage for the case where package.json IS passed via --trust-root (the ADLC-repo posture).

## Acceptance criteria

1. The frozen defaults no longer contain the two paths. verify: `node -e "import('./packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/trust-roots.mjs').then(m=>{const r=m.DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE_TRUST_ROOTS;process.exit(r.includes('package.json')||r.includes('.npmrc')?1:0)})"` exits 0.
2. REPO_TRUST_ROOTS carries both for this repo. verify: `node -e "const s=require('node:fs').readFileSync('scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs','utf8');const m=s.match(/REPO_TRUST_ROOTS[^;]*;/s)[0];process.exit(m.includes('package.json')&&m.includes('.npmrc')?0:1)"` exits 0.
3. Consumer regression test (devDep bump passes without GateDeny) exists and is green. verify: `node --test packages/rails-guard/test/ci-trust-roots.test.mjs` exits 0.
4. README documents the trust-root set and --trust-root. verify: `grep -qi 'trust root' packages/rails-guard/README.md` exits 0.
5. CHANGELOG declares the change under Unreleased. verify: `grep -q 'Unreleased' CHANGELOG.md && grep -qi 'trust root' CHANGELOG.md` exits 0.
6. Whole package suite green. verify: `node --test packages/rails-guard/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: rails-guard: remove package.json/.npmrc from DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE_TRUST_ROOTS; ADLC repo carries them via --trust-root
